messages:
lina: heads-up: new q4_0 export of veridian-v2 vs fp16 baseline on zh-Hans->en devset shows BLEU ~ -3.4. reproducible pattern: decimal numbers intermittently contain a NUL (U+0000) byte inside the numeric token after detok. breaks JSON numeric parsers.
jorge: whoa U+0000 inside output? that's usually an indicator of an uninitialized buffer or wrong string length handling in detok. can you paste a tiny repro and token traces?
lina: minimal repro below (rendered NUL shown as \u0000 for visibility):

```
input: 预计 2025 年 营收 将 达到 1,234.56 元 。
baseline (fp16): Expected revenue in 2025 will reach 1,234.56 yuan.
veridian-q4: Expected revenue in 2025 will reach 1,234\u000056 yuan.
```

lina: token traces:

```
baseline.tokens: ["1", ",234", ".56", " ", "元"]
veridian-q4.tokens: ["1", ",234", "\u0000", "56", " ", "元"]
```

jorge: that looks like the detok concatenation inserted a NUL between subtoken pieces. could be a packed remap table where an offset was written incorrectly (e.g., using strlen that stops at first NUL) or an 8-bit index overflow that maps to 0x00 in some quantized tables.
ci-bot: eval job #15877 finished: BLEU delta -3.4 (p < 0.01). Artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/veridian-q4/15877
qa-harper: any production impact? did canary show parser errors?
engops-rita: yes, ingestion jobs that parse numeric fields into floats crashed in canary when they encountered embedded NULs. rolled routing to fp16 for the ha-zh->en route earlier this morning.
jorge: short-term mitigation: add a post-detok sanitizer in serving that removes/control-filter any non-printable characters inside digit runs (pattern: digit + [^0-9,\.\u002C\u002E\u00B7\u3001]+ + digit -> remove non-digit chars or map to "," as appropriate). low-risk and reversible. I can drop the shim in serving layer.
lina: please do; I'll add failing examples to tests/locale/zh_nul_numeric.json so CI catches regressions.
jorge: long-term we need to bisect the runtime/export changes that touched detok packing. I suspect a change in the quantized export that switched to memcpy from safe-copy causing an uninitialized trailing byte to leak. creating bisect job now.
ci-bot: bisect queued: https://ci.internal/ci/jobs/bisect-detok-nul-15878 (est ~2h).
engops-rita: routing fallback applied: zh->en canary -> fp16. monitor parser-failure metric.
lina: repro script: /tmp/veridian-nul-repro.sh; export commit: d12f9a3; quant flags: --mode q4_0 --detok-mode packed-remap.
jorge: additional debug we should add: during export, dump the detok remap buffer bytes for fp16 vs quant and assert there are no 0x00 bytes inside printed glyph sequences (0x00 allowed only in padding region). also run the same detok bytes through the quant kernel in a local container to ensure no byte-order issues.
qa-harper: will add unit test to runtime-export suite to diff detok buffer byte sequences between fp16 and quant exports and fail if any non-padding 0x00 bytes appear.
engops-rita: filed ticket RD-9812 "Quantized export detok packing leaking NUL into numeric detokenization for CJK locales"; tagging eng-ml, eng-runtime, infra. https://tickets.internal/RD-9812
jorge: once bisect narrows the commit range I will open a runtime PR to fix the packing and add explicit zero-init; until then sanitizer + route fallback should stop customer impact.
lina: thanks all. I'll watch bisect results and validate canary once sanitizer is in. :thumbsup:
